plain: Primary Buttons in light mode now show a visible bottom edge, so check screens that set their own Button shadow or --hds-btn-edge.

steps.plain: The light primary Button edge is now a lighter lip (#424a56) instead of near-black, and Pagination's current page and CodeBlock's copy button are raised; if you override --hds-edge-primary or --hds-btn-edge, check that your value still shows against the fill.
